headline: Point Loma lose at home for the first time this season
dek: Point Loma's defeat by Hawai'i Pacific on Saturday was their first at home this season and their third overall, against four wins and three draws. They have scored nineteen goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and conceded fourteen.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Vanguard have conceded twenty-four goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have scored thirteen; two wins and two draws stand against five defeats.

wire.line: Point Loma's first home defeat of the season came in conference play, to Hawai'i Pacific.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo's draw at Vanguard on Monday was their first of the season; they have won four and lost three, scoring nine goals and conceding eight.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Pacific's draw at Biola on Monday left them with three wins, three draws and three defeats, and eighteen goals scored against eighteen conceded.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Biola's draw with Hawai'i Pacific on Monday was their third of the season; they have one win and five defeats, and have scored eleven goals and conceded fourteen.

next_match.line: Chaminade have lost every match they have played; Concordia Irvine have yet to win in conference play.
